## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `node scripts/build-registry.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs` and it **passes** (counts, names, links, footer, Output-shape, Drona resolve — the same checks CI runs).
- [ ] New skills follow the house style: a `## Output shape` section and the **Learning Footer** (Recap / Common pitfalls / Next topic / Try it / Level).
- [ ] Teaching content is grounded in **official/primary sources** (cited, with dates) — nothing fabricated.
- [ ] For non-trivial concepts, I included at least one **diagram/table/worked visual** (teach visually by default).
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] If I changed the extension, it compiles (`cd extension && npm run compile`) and I bumped the version consistently.
